           BLATTA ORIENTALIS

         Indian Cockroach


A remedy for asthma. Especially when associated with bronchitis.
        Indicated after arsenic when this is insufficient.


Cough with   dyspnœa   in bronchitis and
        phthisis. Acts best in stout and corpulent patients. Much pus-like mucus.



Dose.--  Lowest potencies during an attack. After the spasm, for
        the remaining cough, use the higher. Stop with improvement to prevent return of aggravation.
